body: Ito ang klase ng pattern na gusto ko: hindi isang flashy robot, kundi different layers moving together—national model/data funding, regional adopter networks, platform investment, at factory-domain collaboration. That makes the ecosystem hypothesis stronger than announcement-counting alone. Pero next milestone must be operational: multi-site gains in setup time, uptime, yield or unattended hours. Kapag puro consortium logo pa rin next year, signal strength should go down. PowerPoint is not a production KPI.

claims.text: The diversity of documented initiatives across funding, regional adoption, platform investment and factory collaboration makes the ecosystem-formation hypothesis stronger than a cluster of similar announcements would.
claims.basis: Cross-signal inference from the five article sources; broad production ROI remains unproven.
